This is errata version PC-E2 of [[F-11D Blaster Rifle (Virtual Set 4, Original)]] (version 3 of 4). The current text is [[F-11D Blaster Rifle (Remastered)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[F-11D Blaster Rifle (Virtual Set 4, Original)]]): Virtual Set 4 release<ref name="eh1351-f11d-0">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/set-4-officially-released/ Players Committee Set 4 launch announcement], 29 June 2016. Set 4 became tournament-legal on 2 July 2016. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160702011718id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/set-4-officially-released/ Internet Archive].</ref>. First published 29 June 2016. Text: “Deploy on your First Order warrior. May target a character or vehicle at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if destiny +1 (+2 if fired by a stormtrooper) &gt; defense value.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[F-11D Blaster Rifle]]): Players Committee “Current Erratas & Unlimited Shields”<ref name="eh1351-f11d-1">Players Committee, [https://www.starwarsccg.org/current-erratas-unlimited-shields/ Current Erratas &amp; Unlimited Shields], 16 November 2016, F-11D Blaster Rifle.</ref>. First published 16 November 2016. Text: “Deploy on your First Order warrior. May target a character or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if destiny +1 (+2 if fired by a stormtrooper) &gt; defense value.” '''What changed:''' game text: words removed: “at same or adjacent site”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee Competitive Balance announcement<ref name="eh1351-f11d-2">Players Committee, [https://www.starwarsccg.org/competitive-balance-set-12-preview-cards-released/ Competitive Balance, Set 12 Preview Cards Released], 9 December 2019.</ref>. First published 9 December 2019. The PC card image with this text followed on 12 July 2020 (Holotable commit fdfe14b); it still prints the mark “E”. Text: “Deploy on your First Order warrior. May target a character or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Add 1 if fired by a stormtrooper. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny &gt; defense value.” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “Add 1 if fired by a stormtrooper.”, “total”; words removed: “+1 (+2 if fired by a stormtrooper)”. It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[F-11D Blaster Rifle (Remastered)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-f11d-3">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/f11dblasterrifle.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 commit e8445f0] (1 June 2022).</ref>. First published 1 June 2022. Text: “Deploy on your First Order warrior. May target a character or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Add 1 if fired by a stormtrooper. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny &gt; defense value.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”). It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.
|notes=The December 2019 erratum removed the default +1 and reduced the stormtrooper bonus from +2 to +1. The printable slip and July 2020 Holotable composite share the new game text and the E mark.
